claims.claim_text: Historic health care reform was enacted to provide economic security for families.
Prior to the passage of health reform in 2010, 47 million United States citizens had no health insurance.
Support for increasing healthcare choice and options.
Over ten years, the new U.S. health care reform law discussed in 2012 will save the average Medicare beneficiary $4,200.
Support for ensuring that America's aging population has access to safe and affordable care.
The Congressional Budget Office estimates that if the U.S. were to adopt a single-payer health insurance system, over $400 billion per year could be saved.
